newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore government securities end narrowly mixed.
newsitem.headline: Singapore government securities end narrowly mixed.

text.p: Singapore government securities ended on Monday narrowly mixed in moderate trade on interbank and retail interest, dealers said.
"It was a relatively quiet market," one dealer said.
In treasury bills, three-months closed at 2.85/2.80 percent from Friday's yield of 2.89/2.84 percent and one-year at a yield of 2.83/2.78 percent against the previous 2.82/2.77 percent.
Among bonds, April 1999 ended at S$98.43/98.48 compared with Friday's close of S$98.45/98.50, September 2001 at S$99.03/99.08 against S$96.25/96.35 and June 2003 was steady at S$94.03/94.08.
The overnight interbank offered rate eased to 4 3-7/8 percent versus Friday's 4-1/2 4-3/8 percent.
